SnippetContract.Expansion: SELECT mg.NAME, m.PropertyName, md.Description, * FROM Boa.cor.Messaging m JOIN Boa.cor.MessagingGroup mg ON mg.MessagingGroupId = m.MessagingGroupId JOIN Boa.cor.MessagingDetail md ON md.Code = m.Code AND md.LanguageId = 1 WHERE md.Description LIKE '%Kişinin kimlik bilgileri güncellenmiştir veya%' OR m.PropertyName = 'LetterInformation'
